prompt:
以下はある英語ニュースpodcast記事のFull Story・Point One・Point Twoです。
Point One・Point Twoそれぞれについて、以下6項目を判定してください
(それぞれPASS/FAIL)。

- qa_not_caveat_only: このPointが、研究上の限界・一般化上の注意・免責事項
  だけで構成されていない場合PASS(それらに加えて実質的な新しい内容がある
  場合もPASS。留保だけでPoint枠全体が終わっている場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_full_story_paraphrase: Full Storyの要約・言い換えに留まっていない
  場合PASS(Full Storyの中心的なlogic・結論を語彙だけ変えて繰り返している
  場合はFAIL)
- qa_not_other_point_paraphrase: もう一方のPointの要約・言い換えになって
  いない場合PASS
- qa_explains_why_it_matters: 「だから何なのか」を具体的に説明できている
  場合PASS(聞き手にとっての具体的な意味・示唆がある場合)
- qa_specific_not_generic: この記事のLedger固有の内容に基づいており、他の
  どんな記事にもほぼそのまま流用できる一般論になっていない場合PASS
- qa_adds_new_value: 新しい理解・解釈・意外性・具体的示唆のいずれかを
  実際に加えている場合PASS(Full Storyだけを聞いた場合と比べて、聞き手の
  理解が実際に深まっている場合)

reasoningには、判定理由を1〜2文の日本語で書いてください(特にFAILの場合は
具体的な理由を明記してください)。

【Full Story】
On August 16, the Hanshin Tigers beat the Hiroshima Toyo Carp 8–1 at Mazda Stadium.

The game changed very early.

In the first inning, Teruaki Sato hit a two-run home run to center field. Hanshin took the lead before Hiroshima could settle into the game.

The Tigers then got steady work from starting pitcher Rihito Ihara. He pitched five innings, allowed only two hits, and gave up one run. That helped Hanshin protect its early lead.

Hiroshima’s only run came in the fifth inning. Elehuris Montero hit a solo home run, but the Carp could not add another run.

Hanshin did not stop after its fast start. The Tigers scored again in the seventh inning and added more in the eighth. The lead grew, and Hiroshima had no answer.

The final score was:

Hiroshima 1–8 Hanshin

A quick start became a complete win. Hanshin hit first, kept control, and finished strongly.

【Point One】
Ihara’s night had an extra chapter. He came to bat twice and got two singles, in the third and fifth innings. That made him 2-for-2 and gave him his first professional game with more than one hit. He helped Hanshin in an unusual way, both as a pitcher and as a hitter.

【Point Two】
Montero’s home run also had personal meaning. It was his 10th homer of the 2026 season. After hitting nine in 2025, he reached 10 in Japan for the first time. The swing did not change the result, but it gave the losing side one clear achievement to remember.
